instruction: Improve GET /api/users/ in this FastAPI service. Add an optional activated boolean query parameter. When it is true, return only active users. When it is false, return only inactive users. When it is missing, keep the current behaviour. Keep the existing search, limit, and page inputs. Require limit to be from 1 to 100 and page to be at least 1, using normal FastAPI validation errors for bad values. Keep old endpoints working. Add meaningful public tests for the new behaviour and update README.md with the query parameters and limits. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
